import hashlib, io, json, tarfile
src = "/tmp/bench73420677/app.tar"
dst = "/tmp/bench73420677/app-rebuilt.tar"
with tarfile.open(src) as t:
    files = {m.name: t.extractfile(m).read() for m in t.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
manifest = json.loads(files["manifest.json"])
old_cfg_name = manifest[0]["Config"]
cfg = json.loads(files[old_cfg_name])
cfg["config"]["Labels"] = {"rebuilt": "yes"}
new_cfg = json.dumps(cfg, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
new_name = hashlib.sha256(new_cfg).hexdigest() + ".json"
manifest[0]["Config"] = new_name
del files[old_cfg_name]
files[new_name] = new_cfg
files["manifest.json"] = json.dumps(manifest).encode()
with tarfile.open(dst, "w") as t:
    for name, data in files.items():
        ti = tarfile.TarInfo(name); ti.size = len(data)
        t.addfile(ti, io.BytesIO(data))
EOF
